components: a small left loop rising into the crown
a large right loop curling inward
strokeOrder: circle the small left loop and climb into the crown
without lifting, sweep through the large right loop and curl inward — then lift once
set the pen at the right of the separate lower bowl, sweep around its broad curl, and turn inward along the hooked tail
strokeOrderNote: two strokes — two joined upper-loop movements, one pen lift, then the hooked lower bowl in one run; cited to Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Module 15 and Appendix I Frame 15, ஓ

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Module 15, ஓ, with Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 15 (University of Texas at Austin), p. 196
strokeOrderSource.variation: Module 15 identifies ஓ as long o. Appendix I Frame 15 numbers three movements: the left loop and large right loop stay joined, followed by the separate hooked lower bowl after one lift. This two-run learner order is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Tamil outline; Tamil handwriting varies by school.

notes: Independent long ō opens words such as ஓடு (ōṭu, run). Frame 15's first two movements form the same connected upper family as short ஒ; the larger hooked lower bowl begins after the single lift.
